evidence: Current Kew accepts the species as Texas-native.
Texas records found in this pass are concentrated in eastern counties such as Harris, Liberty, Montgomery, San Jacinto, and Anderson, outside the current target-zone threshold.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not convert statewide Texas nativity into target-zone county presence.

morphology.look_here_first: Treat as a slender eastern Indiangrass comparison. It is generally associated with sandy open woodland and eastern Texas rather than the Central Texas tallgrass settings where S. nutans is expected.
